records.title: Spirit of Excalibur
records.current_rights_assessment: Associated with Cinemaware history, but not in the explicit 2016 acquisition list used as primary family evidence; dedicated title-level evidence required.
notes: Not included in the explicit 2016 Starbreeze Cinemaware IP list used for this batch; do not infer Nordcurrent ownership without further evidence.

key_findings: Starbreeze announced in 2016 that it acquired IP rights to the entire Cinemaware library, explicitly listing 14 game IPs plus the Cinemaware brand and stating that brands, websites, existing products and licenses were included.
Nordcurrent announced in February 2024 that it acquired the Cinemaware catalog from Starbreeze.
Nordcurrent stated in 2024 that Defender of the Crown would be the first property it planned to remaster.
Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns launched in August 2026 through Nordcurrent Labs, proving active exploitation of at least that franchise.
The explicit acquisition lists provide unusually strong transaction evidence compared with many earlier batches.
Titles historically associated with Cinemaware but absent from the explicit transaction list must not be silently folded into the Nordcurrent ownership assertion.
This batch supports adding Transaction Scope Evidence and Explicit Asset Lists to the Rights Graph.

architecture_finding.name: Transaction Scope Evidence
architecture_finding.rule: An explicit asset schedule/list in a transaction outranks inference from brand, publisher or corporate succession.

candidate_notes.reason: Clear ownership route plus strong Amiga recognition; non-Defender titles may offer better pilot feasibility if not currently under active development.
